highlights.title: Belgian court finds Utexbel and its leadership guilty of environmental crimes
highlights.summary: On 19 May 2026, the Court of First Instance of East Flanders, Ghent division, reportedly convicted textile company Utexbel and its managing director of multiple environmental offences, including breaches of permit conditions and the discharge of industrial wastewater, imposing fines of €400,000 and €80,000 respectively for conduct that created irresponsible risks and caused environmental damage.
